notes: four taḥwīl branches: the first three end at «كلهم عن يحيى بن سعيد», the last at «سمعت يحيى بن سعيد»; the tail repeats the one name once for all four (rule 3)
«أخبرني أبو بكر، - وهو ابن محمد بن عمرو بن حزم -» — the dashed identity note is a gloss, left out; this Abu Bakr is not merged with Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba of branch three
«- واللفظ له -» and «- يعني الثقفي -» are glosses, left out; «أنها» is Amra's pronoun, not a link
